correctness.summary: Independent chip-firing/lattice enumeration gives rank 1. Hladky–Kral–Norine additionally identifies this with the corresponding metric-graph rank.

limitations: No algebraic lifting or non-liftability statement is proved.
Edge lengths are fixed to the published unit-length model.

originality.summary: No exact square-backbone D* computation located; nearby trigonal classification results impose stronger connectivity.

scientific_value.summary: A small exact genus-5 divisor-rank invariant useful for tropical/gonality comparisons; no lifting claim.
